justification: Inspected /data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/google/jimfs/jimfs/src/main/java/com/google/common/jimfs/UserLookupService.java, /data/henrique/detecting_smells_study/codex/data/repositories/google/jimfs/jimfs/src/test/java/com/google/common/jimfs/UserLookupServiceTest.java, and its callers in OwnerAttributeProvider.java, PosixAttributeProvider.java, and JimfsFileSystem.java. The class is only 114 lines, has one field, one constructor, two lookup methods, two static factory methods, and three small nested principal classes; all behavior stays within a single cohesive concern of user/group principal lookup and equality. The dedicated test covers only that focused behavior, and the usages are narrow helper calls rather than evidence of mixed responsibilities or low cohesion.
